description: Fork of exp693 (1.4379 @ 97.5M, <100M SOTA). Changes vs exp693: (1) drop q_norm and k_norm on the qk_lut output; (2) bump qkv_lut_init_std 0.001 -> 0.051 to match vanilla q,k post-projection magnitude at init (vanilla q,k entry std ~0.39 after Linear(0.02)*sqrt(n_embd=384); 0.051 produces matching LUT q,k output std ~0.39 empirically). Hypothesis: LayerNorm on q,k erases magnitude info that the model could use to suppress trivial self-attention; vanilla GPT has no norm before SDPA. Param impact: -1536 LayerNorm params. Refs: exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M (with norms), exp684=1.4262 @ 140M, exp476=1.4143 @ 35.8M (vanilla untied).
